description.value: A striking west coast building perched at the south end of Wickaninnish Beach in Pacific Rim National Park Reserve. Inside features exhibits on local ecology, First Nations culture, a replica longhouse, and giant marine mammal murals. The outdoor deck offers year-round views of whales, storms, and surfers along the open Pacific coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Parks Canada visitor centre at Wickaninnish Beach in Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, with exhibits, a gift shop, and an outdoor viewing deck. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned on the website. OSM tags confirm it as a tourism=information office. No phone or address is available from either source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Parks Canada visitor centre on a popular cycling route; a clear destination for touring cyclists exploring the Pacific Rim area even though cycling-specific amenities are unconfirmed.

wow_evidence: Parks Canada interpretive centre at Wickaninnish Beach — exhibits, replica longhouse, storm-watching deck; the beach itself is the star.
blurb: Interpretive centre with longhouse exhibit and ocean deck at Wickaninnish Beach.
